        start_min = start_h * 60 + start_m
        end_min = end_h * 60 + end_m
        tf_start = start_time
        tf_end = end_time
        new_start = max(start_min, tf_start)
        new_end = min(end_min, tf_end)
        if new_start < new_end:
            adjusted.append( 
                (new_start // 60, new_start % 60, new_end // 60, new_end % 60) 
            )
    return adjusted
